Plans.Filter: (info = ANY ('{"Los Angeles, California, USA","New York City, New York, USA"}'::text[]))

((info ~ '^(?:[1-9]\d*|0)?(?:\.\d+)?$'::text) AND (info ~ '^(?:[1-9]\d*|0)?(?:\.\d+)?$'::text) AND (info_type_id = 100) AND ('0'::double precision <= (info)::double precision) AND ((info)::double precision <= '10000'::double precision))

((info ~ '^(?:[1-9]\d*|0)?(?:\.\d+)?$'::text) AND (info ~ '^(?:[1-9]\d*|0)?(?:\.\d+)?$'::text) AND (info_type_id = 101) AND ((info)::double precision <= '7'::double precision) AND ('3'::double precision <= (info)::double precision))
